description: Hermes dogfood follow-up: fix real-browser Vertex runtime crash found after CI passed.
tddConvention: Red → Green → Refactor. First reproduce the browser/runtime failure with a regression guard where possible, then implement the smallest fix, then run the full quality gates. Do not rely only on Vitest/jsdom for this story; preserve evidence for real Vite/browser verification.

userStories.name: Fix Vertex /vertex/new real-browser React/Sigma runtime crash
userStories.dependencies: web/src/vertex/VertexWorkspacePage.tsx, web/vite.config.ts, @react-sigma/core, graphology, React/Vite dependency prebundle/runtime
userStories.description: Hermes manual dogfood found that /vertex/new can crash in the real Vite dev server even though make web-build, make test, go vet ./..., and make web-test all pass. First browser load produced React 'Invalid hook call' and ErrorBoundary TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'useRef') from @react-sigma/core inside VertexWorkspaceForRid/VertexWorkspacePage. A later refresh rendered the basic Vertex UI, so the fix must address the real runtime/chunk/dependency issue rather than only satisfying tests.
bdd_acceptance: Given the app is served by the real Vite dev server at http://127.0.0.1:5173 and the backend is healthy on 127.0.0.1:9117 When a fresh browser context navigates directly to /vertex/new Then the Vertex workspace renders without ErrorBoundary fallback and without console errors containing 'Invalid hook call' or 'Cannot read properties of null (reading useRef)'.
Given Vertex imports @react-sigma/core When the Vite dependency graph is built/served Then @react-sigma/core and Vertex use the same React singleton; no duplicate React/runtime mismatch is present.
Given /vertex/new renders Then the user can see Untitled Graph, Layout, Merge links, Save, Share, Time, Run, and the Sigma canvas without a crash.

Given the regression was a real-browser runtime issue When adding tests or smoke checks Then include a guard that would fail on this class of React/Sigma runtime crash where feasible; if Claude Code browser tooling is unavailable, document the exact manual browser verification command/URL in progress.txt so Hermes can perform final verification.
userStories.notes: Hermes evidence captured before this Ralph run: full CI passed at Sat May 16 00:02:52 CST 2026 (246 web test files, 2718 tests), services healthy, but browser console on http://127.0.0.1:5173/vertex/new showed: Invalid hook call; TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'useRef'); stack included @react-sigma_core.js, VertexWorkspaceForRid, VertexWorkspacePage.tsx, RouteErrorBoundary. After refresh the page rendered, so check first-load / optimized dependency behavior. Hermes must re-run real browser verification after Ralph completes.
